Foreign Affairs,
Crime & Special Branch Station. File No.................... Date March 29, 1943.

SUBJECT: Re: JASDHOOR SINGH

He is 45 years of age. At first he came
from India in 1925 and went to Peking where he was
working as a salesman with an Indian merchant. In
1930 he went to Hankow and was employed as a watch-
man with a Japanese ice factory and was there up to
1936. In the end of 1936 he returned back to India.
In 1939 he left India and arrived at Shanghai on 8th
May, 1939 and start to work as a private watchman at
(Tse Joown) Jiendong and Jnapoo Road corner. In
1941 he was employed as a Police Watchman No. 566 in
General Hospital. In August 1941 he left for Nanking
and was employed as a watchman by Yocheng Flour Mill
(Isialiwan).

Owing to the illhealth he returned to
Shanghai on 4th February 1943. At present he is em-
ployed by the Towa Iron Work as a watchman at 49 Pe-
nang Road.

He speaks a little Russian and Japanese
Languages. He has a good name and well respected
man in the local Sikh Community.

Narain Singh. S.D. 4106

（左侧边栏文字）
Officer i/c Sec. III
